razonamiento: The visual diagram presents a six-node pipeline for IoT acoustic leak detection: IoT Edge Devices (UserConsumerEdge) push sensor data through API Gateway into S3, which triggers/supplies batch processing in ECS. Acoustic correlations detected in ECS are evaluated by a SageMaker ML model endpoint, and probabilities are passed to a human analyst team (UserCompanyAnalyst). A feedback loop connects the analyst back to SageMaker for model retraining. All visual boxes align directly with the spoken narrative components and are corroborated as 'ambas'.

nodes.name: IoT Edge Devices
nodes.notes: Meters, smart fire hydrants, pressure and water quality sensors

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Runs intensive acoustic correlation algorithms on node pairs

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: ML endpoint calculating leak probability scores

nodes.name: Human Analyst Team
nodes.notes: Reviews leak scores, investigates anomalies, and provides model feedback

edges.respaldo: line b0->b1: 'Those files are pushed through API gateway on a daily basis.'

edges.notes: Stores daily sensor files into S3
edges.respaldo: line b1->b2: 'And those files are then pushed and persisted in S3.'

edges.notes: Batch process ingests files for correlation processing
edges.respaldo: line b2->b3: 'The next process that kicks off is a batch process that occurs on a daily basis where each of the files is processed as a node pair to look for correlations in the acoustic signals. And that happens in ECS.'
line b3->b4: 'These persistent correlations are then further classified using a SageMaker ML endpoint'

edges.notes: Delivers leak probabilities to analyst team
edges.respaldo: line b4->b5: 'and then we feed that to our human analyst team who will further classify that leak.'

edges.notes: Feedback from field used to retrain ML models
edges.respaldo: line b5->b4: 'We actually use feedback from the field about every six weeks to further classify and retrain the model'
